card.name: Factory farming and livestock statistics
card.fires_on: Small words and number pieces in text about industrial animal farming, such as antibiotics for growth promotion, chicken raising times, and cow or hen counts. It fires on the spot just before a number, or just before a word like grow or growth.

modes.label: Numbers in farm statistics
modes.description: Spaces and digits just before or inside a year or count about farm animals.
modes.example: nearly doubled from 2.5 million cows in 1997 to 4.9 million in<< >>2007.

modes.label: Linking words before growth
modes.description: Words like to, for, or them right before growth or growing faster in animal-drug text.
modes.example: for reasons still unknown, they allow the animals<< to>> grow faster.

card.writes: It pushes toward livestock and slaughter words such as slaughter, cows, feed and slaughtered.
card.plain: It spots text about factory-farmed animals, especially where the next word is a number or growth.
